scope: All request, eligibility_input, source C01-C10, assessment and response paths, including inherited interaction rows and convenience KnownBool. Containers are rows; * denotes each array element. Observed types are constrained by declared rules; no arbitrary unobserved type is admitted.

lexical.rule: Required field unless a conditional rule says otherwise. Nonempty ASCII strings in records; nonempty Unicode text in external source packets. No implicit trimming, coercion or normalization. Boolean means JSON true/false, never 0/1. Objects have exactly the union of declared children, subject to explicit conditional fields. Arrays are ordered; duplicates forbidden for refs and identifiers.

versions.rule: Record schema/version/sequence: nonnegative integer excluding booleans. request/assessment schema_version exactly 2; eligibility_input schema_version exactly 1. condition value_version and source version: nonempty opaque strings; exact equality at source_versions, never integer conversion.

refs.rule: Ref is lowercase 64-hex digest; exact kind and original-domain content digest must match. FileRef is exactly {path,sha256}; path is relative ASCII with no empty, dot or parent components or absolute prefix; sha256 is lowercase 64-hex. Exact retained bytes required. CaseRef exactly {file,case_id}; case_id is opaque nonempty ASCII and selects exactly one case. Ref lexical/shape defects belong to shape; unresolved well-shaped refs belong to dependencies. Do not use latest bytes.

conditions.rule: Exactly ten ConditionRefs, C01 through C10 once in that order. Each has exactly case,condition_id,value_version; all case refs equal eligibility_input.source_case. Each resolves complete_inputs[condition_id], never expected assessment. Source version equality is checked at source_versions; different case is a bindings failure.

bindings.rule: All context,branch,time,chart,authority,method,assumptions,evidence,admissions equal complete request refs (arrays order included). Preserve B1-B5. Aliases identity equals request identity entity/book/branch; context/branch refs equal request; source_labels equal C08 source values; scope synthetic_only. C01 period start=context; C04 recognition date=event time; C06 price/fair_value and C07 amount=event amounts by exact Decimal value; C08 currency/unit/scale=context.

source_packet.rule: Each packet has exactly value,unknown_reason,provenance,scope,version. provenance exactly kind,origin,source_rule; scope and provenance strings nonempty. Required value keys are enumerated in the matrix. Null permitted only on explicitly marked leaves. Missing is never unknown. Dates must be actual ISO YYYY-MM-DD calendar dates. Monetary source strings use nonnegative ordinary decimal notation without exponent, at most two fractional digits; normalize exactly to event Money with two places. Never round.

unknowns.rule: C03.contractual_date may be null only when party_to_contract=false (not applicable). C05.rationale_available and C07.incremental/would_incur_without_acquisition may be null with nonempty packet unknown_reason. C09 routes are bool|null: null is not-applicable when required=false, otherwise unknown with reason. Null outside these places and nullable reason fields is malformed. Explicit unknown proceeds to semantic assessment; never coerced to false.

routes.rule: Two output routes in fixed Q then O order (identical_instrument_active_market_quote, technique_only_observable_market_data). Values copy raw C09; required=false gives not_applicable; otherwise true/false/null gives qualifies/does_not_qualify/unknown. Unequal-price branch is (a) if either true, (b) only if both false, otherwise unknown. Equal price gives not_applicable. Retain both child findings and reasons even if the other route qualifies.

findings.rule: C01-C10 findings and preconditions exactly once in order. Finding status is satisfied_conditionally/not_applicable/unresolved/ineligible/outside_scope. Projection maps first two to satisfied, unresolved to unknown, other two to failed. Preconditions support equals finding reason. Summary precedence ineligible > outside_scope > unresolved > eligible; reason_codes retain each adverse condition in order as Cnn:status. No omitted adverse findings. The source assessment is comparative provenance, not inference input.

output_binding.rule: Assessment request, eligibility, authority and method equal validated request refs. source_assessment equals eligibility source_case. diagnostic_example equals E01 CaseRef only for I01, null otherwise in retained examples; no journal identity. evidence_level=conditional_synthetic_only and posting_permitted=false. No output upgrades historical or accounting validity.

response.rule: assess_only success status assessed, commit_status not_committed, additional_commit false; request and assessment exact validated identities, all diagnostic journal/delta/receipt/observed_state null. metadata.operation assess_only. Seven statuses retain valid/unresolved/specified_exact/not_established/specified_only_no_runtime/not_assessed/pending in their named fields. Input and producer defects use the separate failure profiles in the supplement.

operation.rule: request.operation exactly assess_only; eligibility profile exactly acquisition-conditions-v1. Dossier and decision_rules FileRefs must equal the pinned documents for this profile. A different profile/rule set needs separately reviewed versioned behavior, not inference from a familiar name.
